description: This file contains the implementation of the AdoNetQueueAdapterReceiver class, which is an internal class responsible for receiving message batches from an ADO.NET provider-specific queue in Orleans streaming infrastructure. It handles initialization, shutdown, message retrieval, and message delivery confirmation, including logging and error handling.

classes.name: AdoNetQueueAdapterReceiver
classes.description: An internal class that receives message batches from an ADO.NET provider queue in Orleans streaming, manages lifecycle, message retrieval, confirmation, and logging.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Returns a completed task indicating no special initialization is needed.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Flags the receiver as shut down and waits for any ongoing storage operations to complete, with error logging.

methods.name: GetQueueMessagesAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a batch of messages from the queue asynchronously, converts them to standard batch containers, with error handling.

methods.name: MessagesDeliveredAsync
methods.description: Confirms message delivery asynchronously by notifying the storage that messages have been processed.
